correctness.rationale: For UConf_2(|I|) the stable-equivalence hypotheses hold at two particles: distinct essential vertices are at graph distance at least 1, and the shortest essential cycle length is 3, exactly Prue–Scrimshaw Theorem 3.2 conditions. The cubical cell counts are (66,300,315), with connected 1-skeleton giving rank ∂1=65. The 315-column signed ∂2 has rank 215 mod 2 independently reproduced; exactly 100 vertex-disjoint triangular-face pairs yield integral zero-boundary torus vectors independently ranked 100 mod 2. These bounds force rank_Q ∂2=215 and β=(1,20,100), with no degrees >2. The pinned full automorphism verifier explicitly computes all 120 graph maps and their signed action on all 100 product cycles, derives H1 using cellular Lefschetz, and decomposes the 10 classes as H1=(V4+V6)^+ +(1+V4+V5)^- and H2=(3V4+3V5+3V6)^+ +(4V4+3V5+4V6)^-. Rational invariance gives a one-dimensional rotational H1 invariant and no full-group positive invariants. These are finite exact results, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: The primary paper establishes general ordered H2 generators, so those are not a new result.
The action is rational and only for the specified standard icosahedral graph.

Neither primary theorem states the icosahedral UNORDERED 120-element characters. The closest indexed full-module findings are dodecahedral and cuboctahedral, which are genuinely different graph objects, not just parameter aliases. New equivariant specialization appears original best-of-knowledge; risk remains of an unindexed all-planar equivariant specialization.
